newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Spanish company to administer Romania fund.
newsitem.headline: Spanish company to administer Romania fund.

text.p: Spanish investment company G.E.D. Capital Development will be the administrator and co-investor of a 40 million ECU ($50 million) post privatisation Romanian fund, a statement said on Thursday.

GED will add four million ECU ($5 million) to the fund's 25 million invested by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the 15 million from European Union's Phare Programme, an EU statement issued in Bucharest said.
The fund is intended to support the capital needs of majority private-owned small and medium-sized enterprises emerging from Romania's complex mass privatisation.

Under the scheme, the fund will mainly invest over the next four years, with return in a period of 10 years, the press release said. It said the return on investment made from Phare funds will be plunged into private sector development.

Romania's mass selloff scheme gave 17 million eligible Romanians shares in some 4,000 formerly state-owned companies in exchange for privatisation paper, a technique which did not inject fresh capital to the companies.
But Western advisers say the fund could provide the long-term finance needed for restructuring and upgrading. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
